title: Categorification of a small simplicial shape
statement: Use [def-coef-complete-algebroid] for infinity-category, universe, and smallness conventions. For every small simplicial set $K$ there is a small infinity category $K^{\mathrm{cat}}$ and a categorical equivalence $K\to K^{\mathrm{cat}}$, functorially up to coherent equivalence, such that for every infinity category $\mathcal C$ restriction gives an equivalence of infinity categories $\operatorname{Fun}(K^{\mathrm{cat}},\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$. Here $\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$ is the simplicial internal Hom, whose $n$-simplices are maps $K\times\Delta^n\to\mathcal C$. Infinity categories are simplicial sets with fillers for inner horns. Smallness of $K^{\mathrm{cat}}$ is in the same universe as that of $K$.
